bagPolicy.summary: The 2026 concert guidance prohibits bags larger than A4 and has no on-site bag storage. Security searches all attendees.
bagPolicy.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

parking.summary: Pre-booked event parking is reached via College Road; do not park illegally or in residential areas. The promoter recommends event bus services.
parking.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

rideshare.summary: For the 2026 concert series, Nutgrove Shopping Centre is the designated end-of-concert passenger pickup area.

concessions.summary: Food vendors accept cash and cards; venue bars accept only cards or mobile payments. Sealed plastic bottles of water or soft drink up to 500 ml may be brought in.
